gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare, as shown coloured yellow on drawing No. KH 2388/1, commencing at its junction with Cheong Wan Road, about 100 m. from the junction of Cheong Wan Road and Chatham Road, running in a southerly direction for a distance of approximately 400 m. and terminating at its junction with Salisbury Road.

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare, as shown coloured green on drawing No. KH 2388/1, commencing opposite the junction of Chatham Road and Granville Road, running in an easterly direction for a distance of approximately 250 m. and terminating at its junction with Hing Cheung Road referred to above.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道之起點位於漆咸道與加連威老道交界處之對面，向東伸展約二百五十公尺，終點與上述之興祥道會合，其位置在 KH2388/1 號圖則上用黃色標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare, as shown coloured pink on drawing No. KH 2388/1, commencing opposite the junction of Chatham Road and Mody Road, running in an easterly direction for a distance of approximately 550 m. and parallel to Salisbury Road, and terminating at its junction with Hing Cheung Road referred to above.

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare, as shown coloured blue on drawing No. KH 2388/1, running in a northerly direction for approximately 70 m., linking Salisbury Road to Ching Yee Road referred to above.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道向北伸展，連接梳士巴利道與上述之正義道，全長約七十公尺，其位置在 KH2388/1 號圖則上用藍色標明。
